methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Compile existing successful and diagnostic E3/config-rule traces into reusable constrained-DSL symbolic solvers that run with zero test-time LLM calls, then ensemble those solvers before invoking a local generator.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .409: build a trace-to-symbolic-solver compiler for config-rule and GAP-4/E3 primitives, evaluate on held-out games, and require new reproduced levels or a falsifying blocked verdict.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: Compiled solvers can overfit the trace families or bake in public game leakage; .409 needs held-out game families, no game-specific literals, and separate oracle-verifier versus sovereign claims.
methods_mapped.name: ReaComp compiled symbolic solver induction
methods_mapped.source_verification: Verified by arXiv API id_list and arXiv abs WebFetch HTTP 200 on 2026-06-19: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05485.
methods_mapped.v408_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4414 found one grounded config rule but no new reproduced levels; Exp 4418 then blocked vocabulary transfer because the local inducer was unavailable. Exp 4417 kept the sovereign gate alive but with graded_gate_fires=0.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Turn each config-rule or world-model hypothesis into an interactive differential-testing loop: query the executable oracle with targeted states, synthesize a candidate rule/program, and refine only from verifier-returned counterexamples.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .409: replace passive cached-candidate reranking with a CodeARC query budget over held-out config-rule states and GAP-4 program families.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: The hidden target-function oracle can become a new oracle if used at solve time; Carnot must restrict it to offline induction and report final solve attempts without target-query leakage.
methods_mapped.name: CodeARC interactive differential-query program induction
methods_mapped.source_verification: Verified by arXiv API id_list and arXiv abs WebFetch HTTP 200 on 2026-06-19: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.23145.
methods_mapped.v408_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4417 shows local open-weight coverage exists at 0.2333 but the verifier gate never fires; static candidate pools are not producing discriminative new wins.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Insert a preemptive verifier head before executing or imagining an E3 action chunk: score action validity and expected advantage, filter low-quality chunks, and resample within a fixed budget.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .409: wrap ar25/tn36/lp85 E3 rollouts in preemptive verify-before-rollout filtering and compare against the Exp 4415 adaptive-test baseline.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: A learned pre-filter can reject the rare necessary exploratory action or learn simulator artifacts; keep exact replay checks and report coverage loss separately from solve wins.
methods_mapped.name: Pre-VLA preemptive runtime verification for world-model rollouts
methods_mapped.source_verification: Verified by arXiv API id_list and arXiv abs WebFetch HTTP 200 on 2026-06-19: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22446.
methods_mapped.v408_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4415 adaptive behavior tests found failing mechanics but still reported new_levels_reproduced=0 and verifier_is_oracle=true.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Keep hidden-state error awareness as a diagnostic feature only: measure whether new multi-step traces contain non-position signal before allowing any localizer to affect selection or repair.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .409: collect non-step-zero intervention traces and run a hidden error-awareness audit; do not use activation steering or probe-guided generation as the headline.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: The paper reports the signal is diagnostic, not causal; using it as a steering reward would repeat the failed localizer line under a more opaque feature source.
methods_mapped.name: Hidden Error Awareness diagnostic hidden-state probe
methods_mapped.source_verification: Verified by arXiv API id_list and arXiv abs WebFetch HTTP 200 on 2026-06-19: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09502.
methods_mapped.v408_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4416 directly falsified the hidden-state localizer: hidden_state_localizer_has_nonposition_signal=false and the probe tied a position-only F1=1.0 baseline.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Represent code outputs as risk-controlling partial-program or candidate sets, then score the set against executable tests rather than forcing one scalar confidence to calibrate across domains.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .409: rebuild the code_humaneval detector as a risk-controlled prediction-set verifier and compare AUROC, coverage, and risk-coverage against Exp 4419.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: Prediction sets can become too large to be useful or can hide wrong code under broad partial programs; require compactness and executable correctness gates.
methods_mapped.name: RisCoSet risk-controlling prediction sets for code generation
methods_mapped.source_verification: Verified by arXiv API id_list and arXiv abs WebFetch HTTP 200 on 2026-06-19: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12201.
methods_mapped.v408_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4419 reports detection_calibrated_multi_domain=false and code_humaneval remains at chance after SteerConf features, with a positive control available.
